tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT --location=***REDACTED*** query --use_legacy_sql=false --nouse_cache \
"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.scaled7b36f6\` AS
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(f1) m1, STDDEV_POP(f1) s1, AVG(f2) m2, STDDEV_POP(f2) s2,
         AVG(f3) m3, STDDEV_POP(f3) s3, AVG(f4) m4, STDDEV_POP(f4) s4
  FROM \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}._train_raw\`
),
combined AS (
  SELECT row_id, 'train' AS split, f1,f2,f3,f4 FROM \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}._train_raw\`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT row_id, 'serve' AS split, f1,f2,f3,f4 FROM \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}._serve_raw\`
)
SELECT c.row_id, c.split,
  ROUND((c.f1 - s.m1)/s.s1, 6) AS f1,
  ROUND((c.f2 - s.m2)/s.s2, 6) AS f2,
  ROUND((c.f3 - s.m3)/s.s3, 6) AS f3,
  ROUND((c.f4 - s.m4)/s.s4, 6) AS f4
FROM combined c CROSS JOIN stats s" 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Create standardized feature table in BigQuery
